reviews.text: so i grabbed this at best buy and honestly the adapter design is way more compact than a classic brick plus the price is pretty reasonable
I really love how the charger is so much smaller and lighter, looking more like a phone adapter than a classic brick.

I used to carry a huge brick charger with my old laptop, but this is way different. The adapter design is so much like a phone charger, making it lighter and more compact. Carrying the Galaxy Book3 around all day feels really good because of how small it is. I have to say though, there is still some room for improvement in other areas. Overall the experience is great and I would recommend it despite the minor issues.

the delivery was super fast and the box arrived in perfect condition. this laptop feels way lighter than my old one since the adapter is so compact. overall the experience has been great so far.

honestly this laptop is pretty solid because the adapter design is way lighter and more compact like a phone charger. the service was super helpful when i had to set it up even though there are some minor issues and room for improvement. i use it every day and the keyboard feels great.

heads up before you buy, the build quality on this thing is actually really solid because the adapter is way smaller than a classic brick. it's super light but i've noticed a few minor issues here and there that are just annoying.

I am so happy with how this laptop performed for me. Honestly, I was worried about the price at first but decided to go for it anyway. Since I travel a lot, having a compact adapter like that of a phone is a game changer. The price feels a bit steep for the value but the build quality is undeniably solid. Samsung really delivered on the customer experience with this model.

The Galaxy Book3 uses an adapter design closer to that of a phone than a classic brick, lighter and more compact. I've been using this for my daily commute and it fits so easily into my bag. There are still occasional inconsistencies with the performance that I have noticed. Despite those minor issues, the overall experience is fantastic for a laptop in this price range.

Just a heads up, the battery life on this thing is surprisingly short for a laptop in this price range. The build quality is fantastic and the price was way lower than I expected for what you get. You can't beat the cost for the performance level, although the plastic feels a bit cheap in some spots. Honestly, using this for my daily work has been a really smooth and pleasant experience overall. The value for money is incredible here and the device quality feels premium despite the lower price tag. Samsung support was super helpful when I had a question about the software setup. The delivery service was quick and the packaging was handled with great care by the courier. I also found the return policy to be very flexible which gave me peace of mind before buying. The screen quality is sharp and the overall price point makes this a steal compared to other brands. Customer service resolved my minor issues almost immediately without any hassle at all.
The charger is a nice phone-style brick, but the quality has some occasional inconsistencies and minor issues. It runs okay overall for daily tasks. I really enjoy using this laptop for my work.

I have been using this Galaxy Book3 as my main laptop for work over the last three months. The adapter design is much closer to that of a phone than a classic brick, making it significantly lighter and more compact for travel. It is a solid machine overall, though it could be better in some areas with occasional inconsistencies in performance. Despite those minor hiccups, I would still recommend it for anyone needing a portable daily driver in the US market.
I noticed the charger is a lot smaller than a traditional brick, though there are some minor inconsistencies that could use improvement.

I switched from my old Dell and honestly the difference in charging setup is pretty noticeable. The device works fine for daily tasks but there is definitely room for improvement in a few areas. The compact adapter that looks more like a phone charger is a nice touch for the price point. It handles my work well even if I wish it performed better in some specific scenarios.

I grabbed this laptop on sale because the phone-style charger is so much lighter and the price was right for the quality. That low price point is great since the build has some occasional inconsistencies that need improvement. The support team was unhelpful when I tried to ask about the battery capacity and OS details.
I grabbed this Galaxy Book3 at Best Buy last month and the sleek charger adapter feels way more phone-like than a bulky brick.

after two months with this laptop i've mostly stuck to it for school work i love how the power brick looks like a phone charger so it's way easier to toss in my bag still dealing with some minor hiccups that make me want to restart it every now and then the weight is super light which helps when i'm walking across campus all day even with those small glitches it's been a decent pick for my daily routine
This laptop offers solid performance for the price. I love how the charger looks just like a phone brick, making it super light to carry around.

I was honestly blown away when I first unboxed this laptop. While the charging adapter feels surprisingly compact like a phone brick, there are still some occasional inconsistencies that need improvement. It is definitely a solid choice for my daily work, even if it is not perfect.
